Let's clear this up: GeneSight testing ISN'T a magic 8-ball for finding the perfect antidepressant. 🔮

It tells us how your body might PROCESS meds (your metabolism), not how EFFECTIVE they'll be.

It's one tool in the toolbox to help reduce trial-and-error. 🧬

Questions? Drop them below!
